interpretation.coupled_six: joint sensors reconstruct six predictive contexts; parity and modulo-three observers see quotients of two and three contexts
interpretation.aliased_six: six physical fixture modes collapse to three behaviorally distinguishable contexts
interpretation.unobservable_eight: eight hidden fixture modes collapse to one predictive context because the observer cannot distinguish them
interpretation.delayed_six: a counterexample of length six refines a one-state candidate into a six-context cycle
interpretation.partial_four: a non-bijective HOLD transition is learned as a finite automaton, not forced into a reversible group or clock model

query_accounting.membership_queries: observation-table cells; explicit requests are counted separately from unique reset words
query_accounting.probe_selection_queries: candidate active diagnostic sequences evaluated against access histories
query_accounting.conformance_queries: bounded exhaustive equivalence checks against the synthetic teacher; these are a test oracle, not available for arbitrary live systems

limits: The teacher has a deterministic reproducible reset to a fixed initial context; real systems may not provide this.
The action alphabet and available output channels are supplied by the interface.
The learner discovers a minimal predictive quotient, not the system's ontological hidden variables.
Conformance is exhaustive only up to the reported input-word depth.
All tests are synthetic and noiseless; probabilistic, continuous, nonstationary and drifting systems remain open.
